name: TapStream Music Bot
description: On-device music streaming, YouTube/yt-dlp resolution, 24/7 internet radio stations, and Android speaker playback.
longDescription: TapStream is an on-device music streaming and audio distribution bot for Telegram running natively on Android ART. Features dual audio output: streams music out loud through your phone speaker or Bluetooth audio system, and delivers playable audio tracks directly into Telegram chats via sendAudio. Integrates yt-dlp API resolution, direct audio stream playback (.mp3, .m4a, .aac, .ogg, .opus), 6 curated 24/7 internet radio stations, interactive queue management, dynamic ASCII now-playing HUD, and hardware volume control.

credentials.label: Telegram Bot Token
credentials.description: API token obtained from @BotFather on Telegram.

credentials.label: Custom yt-dlp Resolver API URL
credentials.description: Optional custom yt-dlp, Cobalt, or Piped resolver endpoint.

credentials.label: Default Speaker Volume (%)
credentials.description: Initial Android phone speaker volume from 0 to 100 (default 80).

credentials.label: Default Playback Mode
credentials.description: both (speaker + chat), speaker (phone only), or chat (telegram only).
